title: Pixel-art tree canopy of shaded leaf clumps
purpose: Generate a tileable pixel-art foliage tile at a chosen art resolution: overlapping scalloped leaf clumps shaded in four tones with dark rims, single leaves or needle strokes, deep gaps, fruit and blossoms, with per-pixel normal, height, roughness and occlusion maps. Use for tree tops, hedges and jungle walls in 2D.

contract.signature: generate(width=256, height=256, seed=0, preset="default", directx_normal=False, **parameters) -> {map name: {"channels", "colour_space", "pixels"}}
contract.command_line: python pixel_leaf_canopy.py --size 1024 --seed 7 --preset NAME --out DIR [--width W --height H] [--set NAME=VALUE] [--directx-normal] [--orm]

parameters.name: art_pixels
parameters.meaning: Art pixels along each side of the tile; the maps enlarge them with nearest-neighbour sampling.

parameters.name: clump_radius
parameters.meaning: Radius of a leaf clump in art pixels.

parameters.name: coverage
parameters.meaning: Share of the clump positions that hold a clump; lower values open more gaps.

parameters.name: leaf_texture
parameters.meaning: How strongly single leaves break up the tone bands.

parameters.name: needles
parameters.meaning: 1 draws short needle strokes instead of round leaves (conifers).

parameters.name: fruit
parameters.meaning: Density of fruit or blossoms on the clumps.

parameters.name: relief
parameters.meaning: Strength of the per-pixel normal map.

parameters.name: hue_shift
parameters.meaning: Hue rotation of the albedo in turns.

presets.name: default
presets.description: Summer broadleaf canopy with a few red apples.

presets.name: autumn
presets.description: Autumn canopy mixing orange, red and yellow clumps.

presets.name: cherry_blossom
presets.description: Pink blossom canopy with white petals.

presets.name: pine
presets.description: Dark blue-green conifer canopy of needle strokes.

limits: Stylized pixel art with the light from the top left baked into the clump shading; clumps are scalloped discs with a dome height, not individual modelled leaves or branches. Clumps are painted from the top of the tile to the bottom, which suits a canopy seen from the front or slightly above. Fruit and blossoms are tiny fixed sprites. The normal map treats each art pixel as a flat facet. Output sizes that are not a whole multiple of art_pixels give art pixels of unequal widths. Occlusion is a blurred-height estimate posterized to eighths.
technique_references: Poisson-disc sampling on a torus for clump centres
Four-tone shading from the offset along a light direction
Scalloped outlines from a sine of the polar angle
Hashed two-pixel leaves and periodic needle lines
